periods.label: Princess, mechanic, and first queen

name.jp: リーシャルテ・アティスマータ

periods.occupation: princess, queen, Drag-Ride engineer and pilot

status.role: supports Lux as queen while continuing machine development

appearance.overview: Golden-haired princess shown in work robe, bridal dress and combat armor.
distinctive: mechanic's oil smell when working late

personality.summary: Proud, emotional, brilliant and vulnerable; draws strength from doing useful work beside Lux.
desires: support him with her own work
personality.inner_conflict: On her wedding eve she works late because she wants to remain useful and connected to Lux.

decision_pattern.style: turns anxiety into action and invention

quote_samples: 我们大家一起开创新王国的黎明！

mannerisms: works in the Drag-Ride hangar late at night
habits.daily_routine: balances queen preparation with engineering work
quirks: consults romance novels but misunderstands intimacy

preferences.work: developing balanced Drag-Rides for peaceful reconstruction

background.upbringing: Daughter of the previous hero line; once a prisoner of the old empire and burdened by royal distrust.
background.pre_story: Princess who helped guide Lux toward becoming king.

lux-arcadia.summary: She marries him and vows to support him as both queen and engineer.

alma-kilzrak.summary: Alma comforts her on the wedding eve and asks about her love for Lux.

rofi-atismata.summary: Rofi's death leaves Lisha to face succession and public leadership.

kururushifa-enfolderk.summary: Often quarrels with her but accepts the shared marriage.

yatoro-kirihime.summary: Night before wedding outfit suggestion comes from Yatoro.

periods.summary: Lisha's episode resolves the emotional meaning of her marriage: she realizes her urge to work late comes from wanting to stand beside Lux, then marries him publicly as the New Kingdom celebrates.

key_events.summary: Reunites with Lux under the stars, shares an intimate night, and marries him the next day.
Uses her crimson Divine Drag-Ride to defeat Hounds pilots during the epilogue battle.
